lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Prime Minister Mark Carney said a "very good trade arrangement" with the United States is possible but those talks are far more complex than the trade discussions Canada is having with China and other partners, The Canadian Press reports.
Ontario Premier Doug Ford tried to say a few lines in French during his speech in Montreal on Tuesday, CityNews Ottawa reports.
Trump meets Xi and Putin in China with nuclear arms and two wars on the table, The Canadian Press reports.

A Surrey, B.C., landscaping company is giving its employees the day off on Thursday when the much-hyped Grand Theft Auto VI video game finally releases, in what has been billed as perhaps the biggest entertainment launch ever, The Canadian Press reports.
Crimea bridge attacked again, Russian governor says, Reuters reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
